instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace stock splash screen in src/App.js with complete React Router configuration: '/' for public marketplace, '/inmueble/:id' or modal for details, and '/admin' for the administrative panel.
2. Implement brand SVG logo reflecting TUACARIGUA.COM identity (#0B2A5B Navy + #FF6A00 Orange) with mountains, house roof, location pin, and cart icons.
3. Use Spanish for all UI text, forms, labels, filters, and status badges.
4. Ensure all interactive elements include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='search-input', data-testid='whatsapp-contact-button', data-testid='admin-login-submit').

5. Populate initial mock database or backend state with at least 8-10 high quality realistic listings in Acarigua/Araure (Casas, Apartamentos, Terrenos, Locales, Carros, Motos) using provided Unsplash image URLs.
6. Build a fully functioning WhatsApp URL generator using encodeURIComponent for smooth user inquiry link opening in a new tab.
7. Build complete /admin section: login view, dashboard stats summary, listing CRUD table, status toggles (VENDIDO, DESTACADO), image URL uploader with instant previews.
8. Include dynamic currency conversion toggle ($ USD and Bs.) with editable exchange rate in admin or header.
